deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 6% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 7% last year; 5%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity 31% (3 years ago 30%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $69.0B, up 8% from a year ago — about 1.0× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $19.5B, up 10% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 39% vs quarterly sales up 5% (days of inventory 18 → 24). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 5%/yr over 3 years and 10%/yr over 5 years.

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $6.3B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($0M buybacks + $6.3B dividends) = 2.8% of the company's market value. Share count up 0.5% from a year ago (about flat).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $13.24, up 1% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 15 analysts raised, 5 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $12.41, up 1% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 16 analysts raised, 4 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Software 46% of sales, up 8%; Consulting 31% of sales, up 0%; Infrastructure 22% of sales, up 4%; Financing 1% of sales, down 4%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +11% vs a year ago · $11.72 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 11% vs sales 5% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: A mixed record: 7 beats in the last 8 quarters, so results are hard to predict.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +5% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $69.9B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 5% vs a year earlier but slowing (from 9% two quarters ago): the fastest growth may be behind it.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 131% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 20× last year's profit (lower than 69% of the last 5 years).
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 27; analysts expect EPS of $4.63, up 2% from a year ago. It usually moves about 5% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
